```python
flatten(obj: Any) -> Tuple[List[Any], TreeSpec]
```

Part of [`evoxc.core`](/api/evoxc/core/)

Flatten a pytree into `(leaves, treespec)`.

Traverses container nodes in pre-order, collecting leaves (non-container
values). Built-in support: `tuple`, `list`, `dict` (keys sorted),
`defaultdict` / `Counter`, `namedtuple`, `dataclass`, plus types
registered via `register_pytree_node`.

## Parameters

- `obj` · `Any` — Any value (pytree or leaf).

## Returns

- A tuple `(leaves, treespec)` where `leaves` is the list of leaf values in pre-order and `treespec` the `TreeSpec` describing the structure.
